Akali

the Rogue Assassin
Mid laneTop lane

Akali is a slippery assassin who hides in her smoke, flips in and out of fights and finishes enemies with a two-part ultimate. She rewards fast hands and good timing, and she's one of the most satisfying champions in the game once you learn her energy and her smoke. She's played in mid and top lane.

When to pick Akali

✗ Better as a counter-pick

Risky blind: common mids with point-and-click crowd control, like Twisted Fate or Lissandra, shut her down. She's best picked after you see the enemy mid.

Pick into

  • Immobile mages without hard crowd control, like Viktor or Xerath
  • Melee mids she can poke with Q, like Irelia
  • Squishy enemy teams with several carries to dive
  • Teams that rely on clicking targets: her smoke makes her untargetable

Avoid into

  • Point-and-click stuns and roots, like Twisted Fate's gold card or Lissandra
  • Fear and dash punishers like Vex
  • Tank-heavy teams she can't burst
  • Teams with lots of area damage that hits her inside smoke

Great teammates

Jarvan IVHis engage locks enemies so Akali can dive safely.
NautilusPoint-and-click crowd control sets up her all-in.
MalphiteHis ultimate groups enemies for her follow-up.

Your team needs: A frontline and some crowd control, since Akali deals magic burst but doesn't start fights.

How to read the enemy team → · Practice drafting →

Strengths

  • Twilight Shroud makes her invisible and untargetable, which wrecks champions who rely on clicking her
  • Two dashes on her ultimate plus Shuriken Flip give her huge mobility in fights
  • Perfect Execution's second dash executes low-health targets
  • Uses energy instead of mana, so she never runs out over a long lane

Weaknesses

  • Point-and-click crowd control (stuns, roots, charms) ruins her all-in
  • Weak before level 6 against ranged mages who out-trade her
  • Energy runs out fast if you spam Q
  • Falls off if she can't find kills, especially against tanky teams

Power spikes

  • Level 2-3: Q + Flip lets you trade into most melee lanes.
  • Level 6: Perfect Execution turns you into a real kill threat. Most of your kills start here.
  • First item (Hextech Gunblade): more damage and healing, plus a slowing active that helps you stick to targets.
  • Two items (Shadowflame): you can one-combo squishy mages and marksmen.
  • Third item (Zhonya's Hourglass): survive the counterattack after you dive.

Top tips

  • Throw Shuriken Flip from max range so you can choose whether to follow up.
  • Smoke dodges targeted spells, but not area spells: don't sit in it against Lissandra's ultimate or a big AoE.
  • Count your energy before you go in. A Q at half energy can leave you stranded.
  • Save the second R for the execute: it deals more damage the lower your target is.
  • Use your smoke to break tower aggro when you dive.
  • Track the enemy's point-and-click stuns. When they're down, Akali wins almost every fight.
